_comment: Icon-only cleanup. Boxes are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in master (1024px) coordinates and affect items/icon_<name>.png only — worn layers are never touched. mode 'identical' (default) erases only pixels matching base_char_master, so the box can be generous and the garment is safe; use it for base showing through, like a neck inside a collar. mode 'all' erases everything in the box, needed when the debris was drawn rather than shown through; keep those tight, they will cut garment if oversized. mode 'under_fill' keeps the item's own silhouette and erases whatever hangs below it, following the shape column by column — for hats, where a brim curve can't be separated from the hair by any rectangle.

sailor._note: White wedge where the girl's shoulder line runs past the boy's narrower body — hidden under her hair, exposed on him. Box holds no collar pixels and only 68px sit over his body, so trimming it costs a speck rather than a hole.
